stage: Post-discovery candidate; freeze before any new validation outcomes
hypothesis: Following an annual-meeting-results disclosure, the starter protective put adds more mean net value relative to stock alone than the equivalent put on matched ordinary days, because entry downside insurance is cheaper without a proportionate reduction in subsequent downside exposure.
strike: starter 5% OTM put selected using the prior session; report actual entry moneyness
entry: Preserve the registered following-trading-close entry after date-only disclosure; respect public filing timestamps when available without entering earlier
primary_estimand: Mean (protective-put net P&L / entry stock notional) on events minus mean of each event's matched ordinary-day controls; the stock leg cancels
controls: Same issuer, year, quarter, weekday, within 63 sessions, DTE within seven sessions, nearest three; no CSV-tagged disclosure within 30 calendar days
execution: Latest valid quote strictly before 16:00 ET; maximum age 60 seconds; buy ask, sell bid; $0.65 per contract per side; no additional percentage spread fee; report displayed size and exclusions
uncertainty: Retain registered connected-component dependence bootstrap, 100000 draws, seed 20261003, minimum five components; historical discovery family is 120 comparisons; no substitution of naive independent-event intervals
sensitivity: all starter fixed horizons plus expiry
existing aggregate 3%/5%/10% strike sensitivities, clearly distinct from bid/ask results
identical event/control cohort for all five strategies
mechanism_checks: event versus ordinary entry put premium fraction
event versus ordinary positive downside magnitude
separate midpoint performance from spread drag
calendar_confound_check: Compare pre-entry realized volatility and time since the most recent publicly disclosed earnings where complete data exist; retain the full baseline and report missing coverage. Future realized earnings dates are not entry filters or matching inputs.
text_audit: Audit deterministic filing samples without selecting on P&L. Do not assume all annual meetings are routine or discard adverse votes to improve returns. Text corrections require a separately documented version before validation.
overlapping_tags: Shareholder-proposal outcomes are descriptive only; deduplicate company-date events and never claim an independent replication from their co-tagging
validation_windows: Retain starter historical OOS dates for a once-only frozen historical replication, explicitly contaminated by prior related research. A judges sealed window remains necessary for pristine replication; do not redefine a viewed window as unseen.
decision: Supported only if a valid independent-window corrected interval lies wholly above zero with sufficient events/dependence information and realistic execution. Contradicted if a valid interval lies wholly below zero. Otherwise inconclusive; a nonsignificant result is not evidence of no effect.
history_disclosure: Selected after inspecting the broad 50-cell bid/ask screen and diagnostics; 120 possible discovery comparisons plus separate team research already exist. Not preregistered before discovery. No validation prices for this new candidate are read by the evidence export.
current_status: Testable candidate, not a confirmed edge; current primary discovery dependence gate fails
